questions.question:
P 3 R I M J 3 Q % W @ / N $ E 5 X Y 1 # 8

Which is the 6th term to the right of 15th from the right end in the above series?
questions.solution:
Given series:-

P 3 R I M J 3 Q % W @ / N $ E 5 X Y 1 # 8

15th term from the right end = 3

P 3 R I M J __**3 **Q % W @ / N $ E 5 X Y 1 # 8__

6th term to the right of 3 = N

P 3 R I M J __3 Q % W @ / **N**__ $ E 5 X Y 1 # 8

Hence, **"option 4"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the element on either of the sides in the given series:

1) **If both elements are given from the same side:**

__
 
• Left - Left = Left (Counting element from Left side)
 
• Right - Right = Right (Counting element from Right side)

2)** If both elements are given from different side:**

 
• Left + Right = Right (Counting element from Right side)
 
• Right + Left = Left (Counting element from Left side)

**TRICK__:**

Right - Right = Right (Counting element from Right side)

15 - 6 = 9th element from right side.

9th element from right side = N.

Hence, **"N" **is the correct answer.

Let the number be n

According to the question

⇒ n = 3 which is odd

Then,

⇒ (n + 1)/2 = (3 + 1)/2

⇒ 4/2 = 2 

Now,

⇒ 2

**∴ The required number is 2**

questions.question:
In the following figure, triangle ABC is an equilateral triangle and triangle CDE is a right angled triangle. If the length of side AE is 20 units, then what will be the length of side DB?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/093db841e326982635f5e473042febcec50af21fd3179aa4c1d0b8e1cbd06e06.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AB = 8 units and AE = 20 units

ΔABC is Equilateral triangle

**Concept Used:**

An equilateral triangle is a triangle in which all three sides have the same length & all three internal angles are also congruent to each other and are each 60°

Vertical angles are formed when two lines meet each other at a point. They are always equal to each other.

**Calculation:**

Now in ΔABC, 

AB = 8 units, so, BC = AC = 8 units (Equilateral Triangle)

Now, ∠ACB = 60° as all three internal angles are equal and of 60° each

Now, ∠ACB = ∠DCE = 60° (Vertically Opposite angle)

Now, in ΔDCE,

CE = AE – AC

⇒ CE = 20 – 8 = 12 units

Now, as ∠DCE = 60°,

So, cos 60° = 1/2

And, cos 60° = DC/CE (Base/Hypotenuse)

So, DC/CE = 1/2

⇒ DC/12 = 1/2

⇒ DC = 6 units

Now, BD = BC + DC

⇒ BD = (8 + 6) units

⇒ BD = 14 units

**∴ Length of side DB is 14 units**

questions.question: If a + b + c = 16 and ab + bc + ca = 78, find the value of a3 + b3 + c3 – 3abc?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a + b + c = 16

ab + bc + ca = 78

**Formula used:**

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca

a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc = (a + b + c) (a² + b² + c²) – (ab + bc + ca)

**Calculation:**

According to the question

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca

⇒ (16)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca

⇒ (16)² – 2(ab + bc + ca) = a² + b² + c²

⇒ 256 – 2 × 78 = a² + b² + c²

⇒ 256 – 156 = a² + b² + c²

⇒ 100 = a² + b² + c²

Now,

a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc = (a + b + c) (a² + b² + c²) – (ab + bc + ca)

⇒ (a + b + c) [(a² + b² + c²) – (ab + bc + ca)]

⇒ 16 × (100 – 78)

⇒ 16 × 22

⇒ 352

**∴ The required value is 352**

questions.question: The idea of passing the Fundamental Rights in the Constitution of India was inspired by the Constitution of which country?

• Right to equality (Articles 14–18)

questions.question: What day of the week was 25 May 1666?
questions.solution:
In an ordinary year, there are 365 days and on dividing 365 by 7,

we get remainder = 1, so this extra one day is taken as an odd day.

Similarly, in a leap year, there are 366 days and on dividing 366 by 7,

we get remainder = 2, so these extra days are taken as the odd days.

**Thus, the remainder, which we get after dividing the number of days by 7 is considered as odd days.**

1666 = we find out the odd days (the nearest leap year + completing year) = 1600 + 65

In 1600 years the odd days = 0

In 65 years the odd days = 65/4 = 16 leap years and 49 normal years.

In 16 leap years the odd days = 32, and 49 normal years = 49

So total = 32 + 49 = 81 odd days i.e. 81/7 = 4 odd days (remainder)

Odd days in May = 145 days i.e. 5 odd days.

Total = 4 + 5 = 9/7 = 2 odd days.
